overview: India's oldest national park, in the Kumaon foothills, with tigers, elephants and riverside resorts along the Kosi river.
fit: Great for the 10-year-old; check the minimum age for safaris in each zone. Resorts keep the 4-year-old busy.
season: Dhikala and core zones open mid-November to mid-June; Jhirna and Dhela are open all year. Nov–Feb is cool; March–May is best for sightings but hot.
